cards.rationale: Bad Left Hook calls Brown-Hedges a useful domestic matchup rather than a routine showcase. Brown is a 2024 Olympian with knockout power but is entering only his seventh professional fight; Hedges is 12-0, owns the deeper professional résumé and most recently earned his best win over Ellis Zorro. Paddy Power directly lists Hedges 9/2 (+450), draw 20/1 and Brown 1/7 (-700), which normalizes Hedges near +507 fair. FanDuel's +470 is the best current aggregator reference, while Unibet has shortened from +475 to +410. The market offers no reason to chase below the disciplined direct three-way +600 threshold.
